attorneys: Robert W. Ginnane for appellant in No. 9. S. Harrison Kahn for appellants in No. 14. Herbert Burstein for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeals from the United States District Court for the District of Massachusetts. Probable jurisdiction noted, 348 U. S. 886.

Per Curiam:

The judgments are vacated and the cases are remanded to the District Court for dismissal of the proceedings in accordance with the stipulation of the parties as to mootness.
